messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to tirzepatide, any other medications, or any of the ingredients in tirzepatide.
There is a list of ingredients in tirzepatide, at the bottom of this page.
Tell your healthcare team if you are planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation.
Tell your doctor if you have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease, a history of diabetic retinopathy or any stomach problems such as difficulty digesting food.
Tell your doctor if you plan to become pregnant, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding.
If you become pregnant while taking tirzepatide, you should tell your doctor.
There is a pregnancy exposure registry for women who take Zepbound during pregnancy.
Talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part.
Call 1-844-524-0039.
Visit https://pregnancyregistry.lilly.com/zepbound.
Triples: [["tirzepatide", "has allergy information", "allergic to tirzepatide"], ["tirzepatide", "has allergy information", "allergic to other medications"], ["tirzepatide", "has allergy information", "allergic to ingredients in tirzepatide"], ["tirzepatide", "has ingredient list", "list of ingredients in tirzepatide"], ["tirzepatide", "has information location", "bottom of this page"], ["tirzepatide", "has administration instruction", "tell healthcare team if planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation"], ["tirzepatide", "has administration instruction", "tell doctor if have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease"], ["tirzepatide", "has administration instruction", "tell doctor if have history of diabetic retinopathy"], ["tirzepatide", "has administration instruction", "tell doctor if have any stomach problems such as difficulty digesting food"], ["tirzepatide", "has administration instruction", "tell doctor if plan to become pregnant"], ["tirzepatide", "has administration instruction", "tell doctor if are pregnant"], ["tirzepatide", "has administration instruction", "tell doctor if are breastfeeding"], ["tirzepatide", "has administration instruction", "tell doctor if become pregnant while taking tirzepatide"], ["tirzepatide", "has pregnancy exposure registry", "pregnancy exposure registry for women who take Zepbound during pregnancy"], ["tirzepatide", "has contact information", "call 1-844-524-0039"], ["tirzepatide", "has contact information", "visit https://pregnancyregistry.lilly.com/zepbound"], ["tirzepatide", "has participation information", "talk to healthcare provider about how to take part"]]
Relations: ["has administration instruction", "has allergy information", "has contact information", "has information location", "has ingredient list", "has participation information", "has pregnancy exposure registry"]
Answer:

completion:
has administration instruction: The subject drug requires the patient to inform their healthcare provider about the specific medical condition, situation, or action specified by the object entity.  
has allergy information: The subject drug requires patients to be aware of or inform their healthcare provider about the specific allergic reaction or sensitivity specified by the object entity.  
has contact information: The subject drug provides specific contact details or resources for patients to reach out to for further information or assistance, as specified by the object entity.  
has information location: The subject drug's specific information or details can be found at the location specified by the object entity.  
has ingredient list: The subject drug contains a list of ingredients specified by the object entity.  
has participation information: The subject drug provides information about how patients can participate in specific programs or studies, as specified by the object entity.  
has pregnancy exposure registry: The subject drug is associated with a specific pregnancy exposure registry, as specified by the object entity.
